Plot national nitrogen inputs, production, and surplus for livestock.

Source: R/input_output_plots.R
plot_input_output_livestock.Rd

Builds a stacked-area plot of Spanish national livestock nitrogen feed inputs (as negative values), production, and surplus over time. On real data feed is broken down by origin (local grass, local crops, imports) and production is split into ruminant and monogastric output using the stock_prod_ygps pin. In example mode a simpler feed-by-destiny breakdown is used so the plot builds offline.

Usage

plot_input_output_livestock(per_ha = FALSE, example = FALSE)

Arguments

per_ha

Logical. If TRUE, express nitrogen flows per hectare of agricultural land (kg N/ha) instead of national totals (Gg N). Requires remote data, so it is ignored in example mode. Default is FALSE.

example

If TRUE, build the plot from a small example dataset without downloading remote data. Default is FALSE.

Value

A ggplot object.

Examples

plot_input_output_livestock(example = TRUE)
